hero_lede: Spin a living 3D globe, pick any of 195 countries and take a spoken tour in its own language, with English translation as you listen.
hero_note: Free to explore. Quiz & Puzzle unlock once for $29.99, with no subscription.
listen_sub: These are the voices from the app. Tap a country to hear how people there say hello.
feat_title: Explore by ear and by eye
tour_title: A spoken tour of every country
tour_p1: Two or three minutes that feel like a local friend showing you around: everyday life, food, celebrations and landscapes.
tour_p2: It is told in the country's own language by a natural, human-sounding voice, with a small English translation under every line.
tour_li1: Photos of the places being described change as the story goes on
tour_li2: The country's flag rises from the globe while the rest of the world fades to grey
tour_li3: Replay, pause and pick up where you left off
globe_p: A photorealistic Earth that keeps turning, with every country's flag on it. Drag to spin it, tap a country to fly there, or switch the flags off for a clear view.
globe_li1: Capital, currency, languages, local time, culture, history and food for all 195 countries
globe_li2: A soft background sound while you explore, which falls quiet whenever something is spoken
phr_p: Pick a phrase, such as hello, thank you or how much?, and hear it said by a local voice, with the English meaning and a simple guide to saying it yourself.
phr_li1: More than 60 languages, written in their own scripts
phr_li2: Filipino (Tagalog), Swahili, Arabic, Hindi, Japanese and many more
pp_p: Pick any country to see its real passport cover. Every visit earns an immigration-style entry stamp, and the more you explore, the fuller your passport gets.
pp_li1: Official covers from each country's passport, where a free image exists
pp_li2: Stamps in different inks and shapes, dated by visit
quiz_p: Flags, capitals, food, sport, culture and world facts, such as how many continents there are or in how many countries Spanish is spoken. Every answer comes with a short explanation.
quiz_li1: World puzzle: drag each country's name onto its flag
quiz_li2: Globe Flag Hunt and adjustable difficulty
kids_p: A bright, playful Kids mode, reading levels for ages 3–5, 6–8 and 9–12, and a dyslexia-friendly reading option. Grown-ups love it too.
more_title: Something new every time you open it
more_today_p: A new country each day, with a question to answer about it.
more_mystery_p: Follow clues about animals, food and language to guess where you are.
more_compare_p: Put two countries side by side, from population to time zone.
more_currency_p: Live exchange rates between the world's currencies.
more_spell_p: Practise spelling country names, letter by letter.
more_family_p: Two-player pass-and-play, and class challenge links a teacher can share, with no logins.
price_title: Free to explore. One price for Quiz & Puzzle.
price_sub: No subscription and no ads. Pay once, and it's yours.
pf1: Every country, in full, with photos
pf2: The 3D globe with every country's flag
pf3: Spoken tours in each country's own language
pf6: Today's country, Mystery Country, Compare, Currency and Spell
pf7: Kids mode, reading levels and dyslexia-friendly reading
pp1: Unlimited quizzes: flags, capitals, food, sport, culture and world facts
pp3: The World puzzle and the Globe Flag Hunt
pp4: Future updates to Quiz and Puzzle included
pp5: Restore on your other iPhone and iPad
price_fine: Bought in the app through the App Store. The price may be shown in your local currency. If you have an earlier Myatlastic subscription, it keeps working until it ends.
trust_ads_p: Nothing to skip, nothing to click by mistake.
trust_acc_p: Open it and go. No sign-up and no email.
trust_track_p: Progress stays on the device. We collect no personal data.
final_sub: Myatlastic 2.0 for iPhone and iPad. Free to download.

meta_title: Myatlastic — Visit every country in its own language
